# cubepath_kubernetes_plans (Data Source)

Fetches server plans compatible with Kubernetes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `version` (String) Filter plans by Kubernetes version.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Available Kubernetes-compatible server plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `id` (Number) Plan ID.
- `name` (String) Plan name.
- `price_per_hour` (Number) Price per hour.
- `ram` (Number) RAM in MB.
- `storage` (Number) Storage in GB.
